# Sigmoidal Functions



```{r}
ps1 <- makepar_F_sigmoid()
Fs1 <- make_function(ps1)
```

```{r, fig.height=3.5, fig.width=5}
tt <- seq(0, 365, by=5)
plot(tt, Fs1(tt), type ="l", xlab = "Time (in Days)", ylab = expression(Fs1(t)))
```
